notes:
- The performance-to-quality slider is now fully adjustable - put it anywhere you like instead of only three fixed positions
- Settings blend smoothly between the two ends, so you can have a genuine mixture rather than all-performance or all-quality
- The slider shows the split you have chosen, for example 70% performance / 30% quality
- The track now fills up to the handle so the position is obvious at a glance
- Clicking Max performance, Balanced or Max quality still jumps straight to those points
